text:
viv: quick design spike 1: thinking about adding a "minimap" to the top of the rules list that shows relative priority gaps and lets you click to jump to a rule. good idea for long policies?

omar: love it for discoverability. can we keep it lightweight? just small bars with numbers, hover shows title. mobile: collapse to a single row of dots.

kelly: copy nit for hover: current tooltip "Rule #5" is vague. use full title truncated: "#5 — Block suspicious email domains" and add aria-describedby linking to rule name for screen readers.

priya: accessibility: minimap bars must be keyboard reachable and announce "Rule 5 of 24, priority 5" when focused. also ensure contrast meets AA between bars and background.

viv: good. another related ask: preview diff UI 1: when you run a preview, show a compact inline diff beside each rule: green check for matched, amber for conditional, red for blocked. tiny icons with sr-only text like "matched 12 of 50". Thoughts?

omar: inline diffs are helpful but could be noisy. make them collapsible per-rule and collapsed by default. show a global toggle "Show diffs" in the dock.

kelly: microcopy for diff badges: propose "12 hits", "3 partial", "0 blocked" instead of full sentences. concise for scan.

priya: ensure the diff counts are exposed to screen readers as full sentences via aria-live when preview finishes: "Preview complete 1: Rule 'X' matched 12 of 50 samples". use polite region.

viv: validation UX: current message shows red text under condition box. propose richer guidance: short error + example + quick fix button that attempts to auto-correct simple mistakes (e.g., missing quotes). Button label: "Fix example"? Too verbose?

omar: "Auto-fix" is concise but could feel magical. Maybe "Suggest fix" then open a small menu with suggested edits. user chooses and it applies change.

kelly: suggestion: when auto-suggest applies, add a small tag "auto-suggested" with an undo link. transparency is key.

priya: a11y: suggested fix must be focusable and announced when applied: "Suggested fix applied: added missing quotes". make sure autofocus doesn't steal context if user is editing other fields.

viv: preview controls: propose rename from "Simulate" to "Preview rules" and add a small slacklike timing estimate next to it ("~1s / sample"). default sample size 20. also add "Show diff" toggle as omar suggested.

omar: telemetry: track preview_size, preview_diff_toggled, minimap_navigate. helps measure feature usefulness.

kelly: pinned rules: instead of hiding reorder affordances, show a subtle badge "pinned" and a small tooltip: "Pinned by org policy". if user tries to drag, show inline toast: "This rule is pinned and cannot be moved."

priya: keyboard reorder: continue supporting Ctrl+Alt+Arrow for power users. announce new ordinal and keep focus. add an undo in toast.

viv: final: i'll update Figma with minimap + inline diffs tonight and add microcopy. devs can review tomorrow and flag any API needs (preview endpoint already supports sample_size and rule_ids).

ux-bot: figma frames uploaded: https://figma.redwood/minimap-diff ; branch created: ui/ruleflow/minimap-diffs by viv. CI started. :sparkles: (build 5022)

omar: I'll draft the small accessibility checklist for this (focus order, aria-live entries, contrast).

kelly: will polish microcopy and the suggest-fix text. thanks team! :heart:
